title: Hong Kong 100 – Mandatory gear
claims: The mandatory gear list includes a mobile phone, a headlamp or torch with batteries, a whistle, an emergency space blanket or equivalent, capacity to carry at least 1 litre of water, 2 energy bars or food portions, a ziploc bag for personal rubbish, a race bib and some cash.
The headlamp or torch requirement applies to The Half and HK100 (100 km); for The Third a light is optional.
There will be random gear checks during the event, and a missing item may incur a penalty ranging from a time penalty to disqualification.
No disposable utensils will be provided, so runners need their own utensils to use the food and drink at checkpoints.
Recommended items include spare clothing, spare batteries, a power bank, sunscreen, a cap, spare socks, a first aid kit and an Octopus card for public transport and vending machines.
